items.title: UPS Partners With TikTok Shop for No-Box, No-Label Returns Service
items.summary: UPS (NYSE:UPS) has entered into a partnership with TikTok Shop to provide an exclusive no-box, no-label returns service for participating sellers on the social commerce platform in the United States. The service will be provided through Happy Returns, allowing TikTok Shop customers to return eligible products without packaging or printed shipping labels.

items.title: What Does FedEx (FDX) New Authenticated Delivery Service Mean For High Value Shipments?
items.summary: FedEx (NYSE:FDX) has introduced FedEx Authenticated Delivery, a new premium service focused on secure, digitally verified shipments. The product targets high-value deliveries for sectors such as luxury goods, healthcare, and other sensitive categories. FedEx Authenticated Delivery is designed to reduce fraud, theft, and misdelivery risk through tighter identity and delivery verification.
